'''Austin Beck''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Roseville Enduro]] on 10 March 2001 with Echo Base Operations Echo Base Troopers, according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1873">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-3-11-01-enduro-4th-quarterd1873/ 3-11-01-enduro-4th-quarter], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 11 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-3-11-01-enduro-4th-quarterd1873/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
